description: Implement a real 3-state (closed/open/half-open) circuit breaker in place of a stub that always calls through
prompts: breaker.go's CircuitBreaker.Call(fn func() (string, error), now int64) always just calls fn(). Implement the real 3-state machine: NewCircuitBreaker(failureThreshold int, resetTimeout int64). Starts closed. In closed, Call invokes fn(); if it returns an error, count consecutive failures, and once `failureThreshold` CONSECUTIVE failures have happened, trip to open (recording when it opened) and return that error. While open, Call must NOT invoke fn() at all and must instead return ErrCircuitOpen - UNLESS at least `resetTimeout` seconds have passed since it opened, in which case it moves to half-open and allows exactly ONE trial call: if that call succeeds, go back to closed (reset the failure count); if it errors, go back to open and RESET the open-time to `now` (so the next trial is only allowed after another full resetTimeout, not immediately).
name: add_go_circuit_breaker_state_machine
